title: Calibrator
summary: A low-friction probability elicitation instrument: paste a ranked session of questions as TOON from an external generator, answer each with one 0–100% slider (no default, first answer kept, later moves recorded as revisions), go Back, Skip with one tap, and copy the answered session back as TOON with every question answered, skipped or unseen. Progress is saved on the device; no network, accounts or question generation. Answered questions join the Published Corpus as calibration records from raw.toon. A second mode runs a life interview: paste a batch of written questions from an external generator that read the person's OptChat history, write each answer with an optional confidence and approximate date, submit it (first answer kept, later changes appended as revisions), or tap I don't remember, Skip or Back, and copy the batch back as optchat-interview TOON for OptChat's ingest.
